claims.text: Role in CD: mood stabilizers and atypical antipsychotics, esp short-term risperidone, may help.
claims.quote: Mood stabilizers and atypical antipsychotics, especially short-term use of risperidone may also be helpful.

claims.text: Lithium label: monotherapy for bipolar I (acute manic and mixed episodes) in pts ≥ 7 y;
claims.quote: Lithium is a mood-stabilizing agent indicated as monotherapy for the treatment of bipolar I disorder: • Treatment of acute manic and mixed episodes in patients 7 years and older

claims.text: boxed warning: toxicity tracks serum levels and can occur at doses close to therapeutic; serum lithium testing must be available before starting.
claims.quote: Lithium toxicity is closely related to serum lithium concentrations, and can occur at doses close to therapeutic concentrations. Facilities for prompt and accurate serum lithium determinations should be available before initiating treatment

claims.text: Valproate (Depakote) boxed warning: fatal hepatic failure, usu in the first six months of tx;
claims.quote: Hepatic failure resulting in fatalities has occurred in patients receiving valproate and its derivatives. These incidents usually have occurred during the first six months of treatment.

claims.text: children under two are at considerably ↑risk, esp on multiple anticonvulsants.
claims.quote: Children under the age of two years are at a considerably increased risk of developing fatal hepatotoxicity, especially those on multiple anticonvulsants
